name: Reading the Screen
summary: Find Life, RF, SP, combo Power, and the juggle gauge.
description: Find Life, RF, SP, combo Power, and the juggle gauge.

pages.title: Life and Rounds
pages.text: Each {tone:life|Life Gauge} is at the top. The {tone:rounds|Round Marks} beside it show rounds won. EFZ has no round timer: the middle readout is {tone:fps|FPS}, normally 64 under Revival.

pages.title: SP and RF
pages.text: The large {tone:sp|SP Gauge} stores up to three Super levels. Here the left fighter has {tone:sp|one SP level} and {tone:red_ic|Red RF}; the right has {tone:sp|three SP levels} and {tone:blue_ic|Light Blue RF}. Both use {input:22C}: Red RF gives {tone:red_ic|Red IC}, while Light Blue RF gives {tone:blue_ic|Blue IC}.

pages.title: Combo Power
pages.text: During a combo, the readout shows hits, damage, and {tone:power|Power}. Power affects damage and usually affects how much juggle time the next hit adds. The move used, height, and character also matter.

pages.title: Juggle Gauge
pages.text: When a fighter is launched, a {tone:juggle|cyan Juggle Gauge} appears beneath them. It shows how long they remain unable to recover in the air.

pages.title: Juggle Gauge: Yellow
pages.text: At {tone:juggle_yellow|20 visual frames or less}, the Juggle Gauge turns yellow. This is your warning that the opponent will soon be able to recover.

pages.title: Juggle Gauge: Red
pages.text: At {tone:juggle_red|10 visual frames or less}, the gauge turns red. When it empties, air recovery becomes available.

pages.title: Character Resources
pages.text: Some characters have an extra meter of their own. That character's guide explains how it works.
